cases.steps: Start the listen host and confirm its own hosting progress and successful outcome.
Discover the host on LAN, verify its signed descriptor, join and observe two participants.
Explicitly consent to a direct session, join its pinned descriptor, and retain relay-only for later sessions.
Wait for the game-issued invite and join through the configured service.
Keep Hide my IP on, verify relay transport, and refuse a direct fallback when relay is unavailable.
Join after the host changes world state; verify the initial snapshot before accepting input.
Enter Sandbox on the host; verify the guest follows once and can use its own participant tools.
Change to a curated world on the host; verify both peers follow the same world.
Move and aim on each peer and inspect the remote avatar pose at both window sizes.
Join and respawn; verify distinct spawn-ring positions without overlapping players.
Both players try to grab one prop; verify exclusive ownership and release on disconnect.
Pick up and release a native object on each peer; inspect the same authoritative object.
Use each player's F5 workbench to spawn an object; verify one shared object per action.
Spawn a robot and give it a host script; verify one simulation and the same replica on the guest.
Play Zombies together; verify shared waves, player-local input and targeted HUD feedback.
Change Chronos scale from the host gamemode; verify guest scale follows and guest authority is refused.
Open each player's pause menu; verify the other player and shared world keep moving.
Send chat from both peers; inspect attribution, delivery and scrolling.
Give microphone consent, hold and release push-to-talk and verify audio only while held.
Trigger robot dialogue during voice chat; verify voice yields and recovers afterwards.
Kick, reconnect, then ban the guest; verify the ban prevents another join by the same identity.
Disconnect the guest; verify participant, avatar, ownership and subscriptions are removed.
Interrupt and restore the transport within the reconnect window; verify identity and state recover.
After confirming NoFeedbackUrl loaded, quit the host; verify the guest sees host left and no migration.
Alternate focus between windows; verify background simulation and input ownership remain correct.
